contentHtml:
New Delhi: In a significant regulatory update, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) has notified the Drugs (Twelfth Amendment) Rules, 2026, amending Rule 89 of the Drugs Rules, 1945 to expand the range of prescribed forms referenced for the licensing of drugs.

The amendment has been notified through Gazette Notification G.S.R. 713(E), dated August 6, 2026, following consideration of objections and suggestions received from the public on the draft rules published earlier this year.

The Central Government has made the amendment in exercise of the powers conferred under Sections 12 and 33 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, and after consultation with the Drugs Technical Advisory Board (DTAB).

Under the amended provision, Rule 89 of the Drugs Rules, 1945, which earlier referred to “Form 25 or Form 28”, will now include a wider set of forms. The substituted provision refers to Form 25, Form 25A, Form 25F, Form 28, Form 28A, Form 28B, Form 28D, Form 28DA, Form 28E and Form 28F.

The amendment is aimed at aligning the provisions of Rule 89 with the various categories of licences and regulatory forms prescribed under the Drugs Rules, 1945, thereby providing a more comprehensive framework for regulatory compliance.

The final notification follows the publication of the draft amendment through G.S.R. 299(E), dated April 21, 2026, when the Ministry invited objections and suggestions from affected persons and stakeholders. Copies of the Gazette containing the draft notification were made available to the public on April 22, 2026, and the representations received during the prescribed period were subsequently considered by the Central Government.

The newly notified rules are titled the Drugs (Twelfth Amendment) Rules, 2026 and will come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.

The latest amendment follows another recent change to the Drugs Rules, 1945, which was notified through G.S.R. 706(E), dated July 30, 2026, indicating continued regulatory revisions to the drug licensing and compliance framework.
